title: Curated Discovery
description: Products organized around interests and lifestyles, not endless scrolling.
detail: Every product belongs to a club — Quantum for technology, Elegance for fashion and lifestyle, NextStop for travel. Browsing starts from how you actually live rather than a flat catalogue.

title: Selected Offers
description: Deals and promotions surfaced across the Club as they become available.
detail: Good products become better when the value makes sense. Offers appear in Deals & Offers and on the products themselves, so you see them where the decision happens.

title: Your Own Collection
description: Save products you love and keep your favourites close.
detail: Wishlist keeps what you're considering. Clip Cart keeps what you re-order. Both persist between visits so you can pick up where you left off.

title: Order Visibility
description: Every order visible with its current status and delivery window.
detail: From the moment you place an order to the moment it arrives, its status is on your Orders page — no need to ask where it is.

title: Product Requests
description: Tell us what you're looking for when it isn't in the catalogue yet.
detail: Sometimes the product you want simply isn't listed. Send a request and we'll do our best to find it — requests also shape what we stock next.

title: Reliable Delivery
description: Dependable delivery across Bangladesh, from Dhaka outward.
detail: A great shopping experience doesn't end at Place Order — it ends when the parcel reaches your doorstep. Delivery is part of what we promise, not an afterthought.
